Join our workOur mission

Our mission

To support, empower and create opportunities for women, widows and the less privileged in our communities.

Our vision

A society where every woman and family has access to support, hope and sustainable opportunities.

What we support

Four areas of work, one goal: women and families who can stand on their own.

Women empowerment

Skills, mentorship and opportunities that help women lead.

Education support

Helping children and young women stay in school and learn.

Widows and orphans care

Practical help and dignity for those who have lost a provider.

Community development

Health outreach, hygiene support and street feeding that lift whole neighbourhoods.

Our programmes

Health, dignity and a meal when it is needed most. These are some of the projects our volunteers have carried out in the community.

Breast cancer awareness and free screening

Each year our volunteers set up in the open air, check blood pressure, talk through early detection and offer screening at no cost. Early awareness saves lives.

Lady Cornelia Donates Sanitary Pads

Our volunteers bring sanitary pads straight to girls and women in the community, because dignity during her period should never depend on what a family can afford.

Street Feeding Project

Under the banner Love for the Street, our volunteers go out to people living on the streets and serve them a meal with a kind word. It is our way of serving humanity, one plate at a time.

Meet our founder

Cornelia Kafui DjordjormeyFounder, The Lady Cornelia Foundation

The Lady Cornelia Foundation, led by Cornelia Kafui Djordjormey, began with a simple belief: a community grows stronger when its women are supported. Cornelia leads that work from the front, standing with women, widows and families at every outreach.

From free breast cancer screenings and sanitary pad donations to the Street Feeding Project and education support, every programme is built around listening first and then acting with care.

Together we can make a difference.
